[/quote] [b]Video Review[/b] https://youtu.be/dRVtqIJlpjE [h2]Cat Themed Balatro[/h2] Take the game Memory, mix it with a turn limit and elements similar to Balatro and you get Replicat. It’s a fun, lighter, less soul-devouring take on the memory genre where the goal here is to similarly hit the target score using your memory alone in matching cat tiles. I liked it because it simply asks you to use whatever brain cell you have left that hasn’t been rotted away by mindless mainstream addictions, and you only have yourself to blame when you fail. The developer is active in the community, talks with players, and clearly cares. He puts in the work, fixes issues fast, and listens. The game isn’t endless, and it sits in that "go wild with builds if you want to" space, but it still gives you a solid amount of playtime for what it is. [h2]Conclusion[/h2] It's a good game. Match Tiles and enjoy the catchy tunes along side the cat themed sound effects, it's pretty rad!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44181848/] 【更多适合Steam Deck的好游戏推荐，请关注GPD掌机鉴赏家！】[/url] 如果翻翻乐和肉鸽卡牌生了一只猫，大概就是《双喵成行》的样子。游戏把经典的“配对消除”玩出了花：每局开局像在玩记忆游戏，但很快你会发现，这其实是一场脑洞大开的卡牌构筑狂欢——毕竟，谁能拒绝用“发情青蛙头”王牌强行配对，或者用幽灵牌白嫖分数呢？ 表面是翻牌配对凑分数，实则需要权衡行动力、回合数和卡牌效果。比如，黄色卡牌能赚金币换资源，紫色卡牌玩随机倍率翻盘，而绿色卡牌效果离谱到能改写规则——比如自动翻牌、保留牌面甚至复制效果。最搞笑的是BOSS战：突然禁止某种颜色卡牌，或者配对失败就扣分，逼得人当场变阵。 游戏最大的快乐来源是各种梗图猫脸：嫌弃猫、震惊猫甚至“弱智猫”都被印在卡牌上，结算时喵叫和“超级咕噜”特效简直魔性。细节也埋了梗，比如退出游戏时可能被猫猫贴脸彩蛋袭击。 虽然道具能降低难度（比如永久显示牌面），但后期牌库膨胀+随机换位事件依然考验记忆力。不过肉鸽成长感很强：失败能解锁新卡组和道具，比如“野火火柴盒”锁死删卡价格，养成后爽感倍增。 如果你喜欢《小丑牌》的构筑逻辑，又爱猫meme的沙雕气质，这杯28.8元的猫咖值得猛吸！——当然，建议先备个笔记本记牌，别学我翻完就忘。 推荐人群：肉鸽爱好者、猫奴、追求轻量但上头的策略玩家

[h1]震惊！两只哈吉咪的虐恋竟是如此。。。[/h1] 近日，一位土耳其独立游戏制作人打造了一款卡牌肉鸽游戏，真可谓是魔丸降世。他制作的游戏《双喵成行》将经典的翻翻乐玩法和肉鸽机制结合在了一起，笔者认为这一定是一款惊喜之作！ [h2]游玩体验：简单但耐玩[/h2] 游戏的玩法非常简单，您有一个目标，姑且算他是1000分吧，在你面前放了一堆扣起来的牌，你要同时翻出一对牌，才能获得牌面上的分数。但制作人加大了难度，你需要在他规定的回合内，用他规定的回合数之内获得胜利，不然就只能遗憾离场了。 什么？你觉得这很无聊？nonono，游戏的另一大新意就是，他提供了商店功能，你可以在这里买到各种各样的新牌组，以及非常多的小物件，其中不乏包含了非常多的“轮椅”。比如能够让所有点数×3的超级喵喵牌，虽然你配对了这张牌之后这个回合将直接结束，但你可以将其作为你的最后一组牌（每回合你可以出的牌组有上限）。这样一来，你将更加容易达到目标。 什么？你觉得有了那么多轮椅，游戏将会变得很简单？并非并非并非，令笔者出乎意料的是，一个翻翻牌子的游戏，居然也做出了boss战，每轮boss战都会有负面buff，让你的游戏难度大大增加。同时，游戏还有难度升级，分为一二三四四个挡位，一级更比一级难！另外还有专家难度，额外增加了时间上限，这意味着你的思考时间将大大减少！ [h2]总结：新意之作[/h2] 此外，游戏还做了非常多的彩蛋，譬如当你在第一回合中就赢得了游戏的胜利，就会有一大堆猫猫冒出来，发出噜噜声；譬如当你结束游戏的时候，作者则会贴上他自己养的小猫（真是太有爱了）。 如果你也喜欢猫猫和肉鸽，那我推荐一试！ [quote]欢迎关注三真万法鉴赏组: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45742107/ 欢迎加入三真万法鉴赏组: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/szwf [/quote]

I love cats & I love roguelikes, so this was an instant purchase for me. I don't have too many hours on it yet, but have been playing on steam deck and it works pretty well. The game is fun and the mechanics are intuitive--I'm still learning about combos and getting new cards to try. It is worth noting however that the game does require some level of memorization skill and spacial reasoning as it's fundamentally a 'match-two' conceit involving revealing/matching the cards. Despite my poor memory personally, I'm still having a lot of success and progressing, but in higher levels it might be worthwhile to keep a notepad handy. I'm excited to keep learning more! My only main complaint is that (at least on deck) the cursor is really difficult to use at times--not always clear where/how its moving on the screen--and it's not always clear what you're selecting at any given time, especially on more complex interfaces like the shop. I hope the dev will add a setting at some point to highlight selected items more explicitly or something for people who struggle with that. All in all, very worth it, especially at a discount :). I'm always excited to discover new cat related games coming out, and appreciate the dev for their hard work!

[h1]A Fun Balatro-like With Memory Tiles And Cat Memes[/h1] I've played one memory-tile roguelike before, but that game barely scratches the surface of the potential these two gameplay structures can conjure. Here comes Replicat. Even though this roguelike imitates Balatro's formula a bit too literally, it is still a good game that can satisfy your number-generating thrill. Plus, cards are full of cat memes. What's not to love? [h2]Things I Like About Replicat:[/h2] [list] [*][b]Simple Gameplay Loop:[/b] The premise is simple. You flip cards and find the same ones to pair them up within 16 moves. You can only have five pairs each turn, and the scoring order goes from left to right. Beware, though; you can't manually swap the pair order around. What you pair up first is the first to be calculated, so it is best to pair additive bonuses first before pairing multiplicative ones. This design adds an interesting layer of thinking to your card-flipping method. [*][b]More Strategizing, Less Memorizing:[/b] Interestingly, this memory tile roguelike is not all about memorizing the cards you flip but more about strategically purchasing curios and cards in the shop. Similar to Balatro, getting the right combination is key to achieving ridiculous number generation. Even if you are not very good with memorizing cards, there are some rule-bending curios or cards to help you make better use of the 16 moves per turn, such as auto-pairing the first card you flip, placing colored stickers on cards, or even pairing up the wrong cards together. [*][b]Lovely Cat Aesthetic:[/b] The game has rather simple art design, but of course that pales in comparison to all the funny cats drawn on each card. Cat memes, emojis in cat forms, and even the sound effects of both you scoring high points and low points are all about cats. I must admit, this all-cat commitment really helps elevate the gameplay in a non-mechanical way. Seeing more and more cats piling up on your screen when you score higher than the goal easily makes me want to play more. [/list] [h2]Things I Dislike About Replicat:[/h2] [list] [*][b]RNG:[/b] Sadly, we still need to address the elephant in the room. RNG still haunts this type of game like a plague. Buying the right curios and cards is only half of the game. At the end of the day, you are still at the mercy of RNG when it comes to card placement. An unfavorable shuffle can ruin your run instantly even if you have a winning deck. Imagine how frustrating it is to flip two rows of cards without finding a single pair. [*][b]Brutal Bosses:[/b] To be fair, this is not just Replicat's problem. Every single number-generating roguelike has this kind of boss design philosophy, and I am surprised it doesn't get complained about enough. There are always specific debuffs that severely cripple certain playstyles, especially when you are in late-game rounds. I always have a bitter taste towards this kind of difficulty design. Straight up disabling or heavily hampering certain aspects of the gameplay is just not fun to deal with. [/list] [b]中文小簡評[/b] 記憶翻牌類型的roguelike之前有玩過一款，可惜那款的玩法略顯平庸，明顯有很多未完全摸索出來的可能性，而《Replicat》雖然本質上來就是《小丑牌》的翻版，但重複遊玩性還是比前者高很多，再說所有卡牌上都畫有可愛的貓咪迷因圖，能不愛嗎？ [b]喜歡的點[/b] [list] [*]玩法很簡單，每回合有16次翻牌次數，一回合最多只能湊五個配對，分數計算順序是由左至右，值得注意的是你不能手動更改計分順位，因此最佳做法是優先湊出兩、三對加分牌再湊乘法牌，這項設計讓你在策略性翻牌上需要多留一個心眼。 [*]有趣的是，《Replicat》並不完全講究記憶翻牌，而是​​更注重策略性購買道具和不同屬性的卡牌。與《小丑牌》相同，遊戲主打道具與卡牌互動打造各式連鎖加成，即使你記憶力不好也能透過道具打破規則，幫助你更有效率地利用每回合16次的翻牌機會，像是自動配對你翻開的第一張卡、在卡背貼上各色貼紙，甚至是強行將錯誤的卡牌配對在一起等。 [*]遊戲畫面簡潔有力，充分將滑稽的貓咪梗圖凸顯出來，無論是貓咪表情包、貓咪迷因，甚至得分高低的音效都有貓咪叫聲，透過這種「全貓」元素成功以非機制性質的方式提升遊玩體驗，特別是刷分刷超過目標時，螢幕會開始一層一層堆貓，看上去十分療癒。 [/list] [b]不喜歡的點[/b] [list] [*]可惜好玩歸好玩，遊戲最終還是難逃隨機性的魔掌，即使道具和卡牌買的再好，獲勝的關鍵依然要看隨機性臉色，想像一下翻了兩排卡還是湊不出一對，那種挫折感難以釋懷。 [*]其實這點不能只怪《Replicat》，所有同類型roguelike都有這個難度曲線問題，總會有些Boss設計是針對削弱特定玩法，前期還好，到後期很容易變成翻車的關鍵，我真的很不喜歡這種直接拔掉或過度打壓某種玩法的難度設計。 [/list] [quote=author]If you like what I write, please consider a follow to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45738167/]my curator[/url] page, thanks! 如果你喜歡我寫的東西，可以追蹤[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45738167/]我的鑑賞家[/url]喔！[/quote]
